source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.4 with Figs. 9.14 and 9.15 (PDF 200-201).

blocks.text: Maan lein nuqtai charges q1, q2, q3, ..., qn kisi be-qaida shakal ki band sath ke andar kahin bhi phaile hain (Fig. 9.14). Chunke har charge ka flux phi_e = q/eps0 hai, band sath se electric flux phi_e = q1/eps0 + q2/eps0 + q3/eps0 + ... + qn/eps0 = (1/eps0) x (q1 + q2 + q3 + ... + qn) = (1/eps0) x (band sath ke andar kul charge), yaani phi_e = (1/eps0) x Q ... (9.14), jahan Q = q1 + q2 + q3 + ... + qn band sath ke andar kul charge hai.

blocks.alt: Jamni be-qaida band sateh chhe charges ko gherti hai, kuch musbat kuch manfi, q1 se q6. Dabbe mein Gauss ka qanoon: sateh se kul flux, andar ke charges ke majmue ko epsilon0 se taqseem karne ke barabar hai.
blocks.caption: Band sateh ke andar kai charges (Figure 9.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Gauss ka qanoon
blocks.text: Kisi bhi band sath se kul electric flux us ke andar band kul charge ka 1/eps0 guna hai.

Gauss ka qanoon mukhtalif charge tarteebon ki electric intensity nikalne mein lagaya ja sakta hai. Aisi tamam sooraton mein ek khayali band sath li jati hai jo us nuqte se guzre jahan electric intensity nikalni ho. Is band sath ko Gaussian surface kehte hain; ise is tarah chuna jata hai ke us se flux aasani se nikal sake.

Radius R ka conducting kurra lein jis par charge q hai. Tamam charge kurre ki sath par yaksan phaila hai (Fig. 9.15). Kurvi tanasub (spherical symmetry) se electric field har jagah radial hai, aur us ki miqdar sirf markaz se faasle r par munhasir hai; yun conductor ke hum-markaz kisi bhi radius r ki kurvi sath par E yaksan hai. Hum apni Gaussian surface R se bare radius r ka khayali kurra lete hain.

blocks.alt: Radius R ka conducting kurra jis ki sateh par musbat charge q hai, field lines bahar ki taraf. Us ke gird radius r ka dashed jamni kurra Gaussian surface hai. Dabba kehta hai bahar E = q / (4 pi epsilon0 r^2), jaise sara charge markaz par ho, aur conductor ke andar E = 0.
blocks.caption: Charged conducting kurra aur Gaussian surface (Figure 9.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Gaussian kurre ka raqba 4 pi r^2 hai, aur chunke E us par yaksan hai, kul flux phi_e = EA = E x 4 pi r^2. Gauss ke qanoon se phi_e = q/eps0. Lihaza E x 4 pi r^2 = q/eps0, ya E = (q/eps0)(1/(4 pi r^2)) = (1/(4 pi eps0)) (q/r^2). Yeh dikhata hai ke kurre ke bahar kisi bhi nuqte par field waisi hi hai jaise sara charge us ke markaz par jama ho. Kurre ke bilkul bahar, jahan r = R, E = (1/(4 pi eps0)) q/R^2 ... (9.15); vector shakal mein E = (1/(4 pi eps0)) (q/R^2) r (hat), jahan r (hat), E ki simt hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar rubber ka charged ghubbara kurvi ho aur charge us ki sath par yaksan phaila ho to kya andar E lazman sifar hai (constructed response 9.2)? Musbat charge q ki field mein be-charge conducting khokhla kurra rakha hai; khol (shell) se khalis flux kya hai (constructed response 9.4)?
blocks.explanation: Haan. Ghubbare ke andar khinchi kurvi Gaussian surface koi charge nahi gherti, to us se flux sifar hai, aur tanasub se E us poori sath par ek jaisa hoga, to khud E andar sifar hona chahiye. Be-charge khol se khalis flux sifar hai: khol koi khalis charge nahi gherta, to jitni field lines dakhil hoti hain utni hi nikalti hain.

items: Gauss ka qanoon: phi_e = Q/eps0 (9.14), kisi band sath se kul flux andar band charge ka 1/eps0 guna. Gaussian surface matlooba nuqte se guzarti khayali band sath hai.
Charged conducting kurra: charge sath par; bahar E = (1/(4 pi eps0)) q/r^2 jaise charge markaz par ho; bilkul bahar E = (1/(4 pi eps0)) q/R^2 (9.15).
